faqs.q: My dog knows the basics but ignores me when there are distractions. Which course should we join?
faqs.a: That is what Silver and Gold are for. Silver reinforces recall with other people and their dogs walking around you, and adds a change of pace, a one-minute stay and the instant down; Gold is mainly off-lead obedience to a high standard, with recall and a three-minute stay while dogs run about and people walk around. You can join either without having done the courses below it, as long as your dog is at the relevant obedience level — tell Gaynor what your dog can already do and she will come back to you on which is the right course to start on.

faqs.q: Can I come to the Silver course if I have not attended the Bronze course?
faqs.a: Yes, you can, if your dog is at the relevant obedience level.
